note: Cold storage index. Bundles are gzip JSONL; entries not in git carry the recipe to rebuild them.

polymarket-closed-markets.name: polymarket-closed-markets
polymarket-closed-markets.schema: value = raw Gamma market row; observed_at = closedTime

polymarket-price-history-daily.name: polymarket-price-history-daily
polymarket-price-history-daily.recipe: CLOB /prices-history?interval=max&fidelity=1440 for the YES token of the 400 largest resolved markets
polymarket-price-history-daily.schema: value = {market_id, token, p, t}; one row per day

polymarket-books-snapshot.name: polymarket-books-snapshot
polymarket-books-snapshot.recipe: CLOB /book for both tokens of the 300 most active markets (one snapshot)

kalshi-settled-markets.name: kalshi-settled-markets
kalshi-settled-markets.schema: value = raw Kalshi market row; observed_at = settlement_ts

kalshi-candles.name: kalshi-candles
kalshi-candles.recipe: /series/{series}/markets/{ticker}/candlesticks for the 120 most traded settled markets
